nodes.name: Start
nodes.notes: From the collection schedule, for a source of type watch: a site without a feed, read by watching one of its listing pages. Gets the source as the schedule's Mark started gives it: source_id, url, fetch_full_text, publisher.

nodes.name: Look for new links
nodes.notes: The dashboard reads the page, as its robots.txt allows, remembers every link it has had, and sends the new ones to the ingest API like any collector, so the same checks apply. It holds the rules for what counts as an article's link: dashboard/app/services/watch.py, db/init/36-sources.sql.
